title: Saudi Beef Stew
description: A hearty beef stew from Saudi Arabia, slow-cooked in the oven to perfection. This dish is a staple of Saudi cuisine, with tender beef and flavorful spices.
instructions: Season the beef with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, and tomato paste to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Return the beef to the pot and add enough water to cover the meat.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the stew for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
